CLOUD REVIEWER seat for PR #2586 of tvofi/heatpump_optimizer, at head d3e34be538b02f1186419a3e7e4220bdf269803d. Bus nonce: 1ebc1fe85a6438a89a0e5b7681c01870. Never send push notifications.
Setup: `git fetch --unshallow --tags origin`. The toolchain (venv python, node, gh) is on PATH from the environment. Run anything heavy in the background with Monitor and no timeout.
Role: read dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md and its rules from main, and follow them exactly. Fetch the PR head with `git fetch origin d3e34be538b02f1186419a3e7e4220bdf269803d`; the PR body is in the PR. Verify each claim adversarially: mutate the fix and check the tests fail, and check every figure in the body at this head. Check that it merges with origin/main (`git merge-tree --write-tree`) and read CI on this head from the check-runs API.
Output: in a fresh directory of your own (`W=$(mktemp -d)`), write verdict.md, whose first line is exactly `Fix review: merge d3e34be538b02f1186419a3e7e4220bdf269803d` or `Fix review: blocked d3e34be538b02f1186419a3e7e4220bdf269803d <class>: <reason>` (no brackets; the class is lower-case letters and dashes), in the format the role file gives, then a blank line, then `bus-nonce: 1ebc1fe85a6438a89a0e5b7681c01870`; put the evidence in `ev/` beside it, and make at least one file under `ev/` contain the full 40-hex head `d3e34be538b02f1186419a3e7e4220bdf269803d` (e.g. `ev/HEAD.txt` holding the head you reviewed, beside your command output): bus.sh refuses a verdict whose `ev/` names no head. Do NOT run bus.sh: its dispatch record lives on the orchestrator's machine, which publishes the verdict there (cloud_relay.sh). Return the verdict on a probe ref, and push nothing else; this builds one parentless commit with a private index and touches no branch of your checkout: `R=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel); G=$(git rev-parse --absolute-git-dir); mkdir -p $W/pr && cp -r $W/verdict.md $W/ev $W/pr/ && cd $W/pr && T=$(GIT_DIR=$G GIT_INDEX_FILE=$W/idx GIT_WORK_TREE=$W/pr sh -c 'git add -A -f . && git write-tree') && C=$(GIT_DIR=$G git -c user.name=seat -c user.email=seat@users.noreply.github.com commit-tree $T -m "verdict 2586 d3e34be538b02f1186419a3e7e4220bdf269803d") && git -C $R push -q origin $C:refs/heads/probe/rev-2586-1ebc1fe8`. That ref is the return signal. Do not post comments, approve or merge.
Never write to any branch except your return refs. Never work around a hook or a refusal; report it in your result instead.

Brief (snapshotted when this payload was rendered):
First review of PR #2586 (R10-FLOW-DESIGN-POLICY, branch fix/r10-flow-design-policy). POLICY PR: every file it changes is code-owned (dev/governance/roles/, dev/governance/decisions/, CLAUDE.md, dev/governance/config/policy_budgets.json); it merges only on the orchestrator's approving review under mandate 6319294694. Group spec: pack file dev/programme/flow-study/roster/groups/R10-FLOW-DESIGN-POLICY.json plus the design-seats pack (git fetch origin claude/dazzling-gauss-7l3u2b; dev/programme/flow-study/design-seats/, owner rulings R16-R19 = #201 comment 6322679091 and addendum 6322712314 which says decision 0012 is REVOKED, not only voided; the decision record landing here keeps the file as history). Verify: (1) the two new role contracts (designer, design-review) match the DRAFTs at pack pin 30c57744a in substance and carry rule 19's marker grammar `Carry: dismissed: <reason>` with the colon; (2) decision 0012 is revoked in the record per the addendum, with the file kept as history, and no other policy file still treats 0012's moratorium as in force (git grep the corpus; list hits); (3) CLAUDE.md edits are limited to the index rows the design seats need, nothing that loosens a rule; (4) the three raises in policy_budgets.json (corpus_tokens 61026 -> 62423 and two new per-file entries) are the real measured figures: re-run the policy budget measurement at the head, and check the body's `## Raise justification` records each payment tried plus an `Architecture score: dS` line (run tools/audit/archscore/ before and after if the body claims it); a raise without payments tried is a block; (5) the corpus gates (python3 tests/entities.py policy checks, policy_lint, rules_sync --check for .cursor/.claude generated rules, brief_lint) pass; (6) the body's `## Red checks` answers every red at the head (budget-raise-gate is red by design until the owner approves at this head; nightly-status grades main); git merge-tree --write-tree origin/main <head> is clean. Standing rule 19: every observation ends with `Carry: <GROUP>` (a group on origin/handoff/audit-r10-roster), `Carry: #<issue>` or `Carry: dismissed: <reason of two or more words>` followed by (item <id>); run python3 tools/audit/carry_audit.py --roster-ref origin/handoff/audit-r10-roster check over your verdict text and require 0 unrouted. Follow dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md. First line `Fix review: merge <head>` or blocked.
